title: My Design Process

movements.heading: Stare at the problem
movements.body: A problem, an idea, a feeling, or simply a “what if?”

movements.heading: Make a mess
movements.body: Ideas, references, sketches, questionable concepts. Everything goes in.

movements.heading: Find the vibe
movements.body: Turn the chaos into a visual direction that actually makes sense.

movements.heading: Make it work
movements.body: Design, prototype, test, break, fix. Repeat.

movements.heading: Ship it
movements.body: Polish the details, overthink them one last time, then let it exist in the wild.
